aboutMe: Senior Software Engineer specializing in TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, Java, and MongoDB. Core philosophy: pragmatic simplicity—preventing over-engineering to deliver clean, maintainable code and accessible documentation. Acts as team facilitator and empathetic mentor, driving continuous learning and onboarding efficiency. Leads internal R&D: Go Onboarding CLI Tool (automates health checks/Git Flow), TypeScript Workflow Engine (open-source execution paradigms), TypeSpec API Toolkit (DX scaffolding + automated OpenAPI). Outside engineering: Secretary & Treasurer for RUNTS-registered cultural association, directing admin/financial compliance, authoring board minutes and annual balance sheets.

highlights.title: Core Product Engineering
highlights.description: Lead end-to-end development of Anatomical Pathology reporting suite; maintain Angular monorepo, build event-driven backend with Vert.x/Node.js/MongoDB for healthcare providers.

highlights.title: Architecture & API Design
highlights.description: Define technical specs, data models, REST APIs with Product Architect; build integration layers connecting to hospital enterprise systems for clinical data aggregation.

highlights.title: AI Integration & Developer Experience
highlights.description: Implement AI flows to automate dev tasks; adopted TypeSpec for automated API docs replacing manual Swagger, significantly boosting developer experience.

highlights.title: Documentation & Delivery Support
highlights.description: Author functional docs on Confluence/GitHub Wiki; guide delivery teams through installations/upgrades, reducing issue resolution time.

highlights.title: Mentoring, Recruiting & Knowledge Sharing
highlights.description: Mentor engineers reducing time-to-autonomy to months; conduct TypeScript/Angular technical interviews; lead workshops on standards and R&D findings.
